content: Dr. Francesco Branca serves as the Director of the Department of Nutrition for Health and Development at the World Health Organization (WHO), located at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Richard Brennan is the Director of the Department of Emergency Risk Management and Humanitarian Response at WHO, also based at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Gottfried Otto Hirnschall leads the Department of HIV/AIDS at WHO, headquartered at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Knut Lönnroth is a Medical Officer in the Global TB Programme at WHO, located at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Elizabeth Mason is the Director of Maternal, Newborn, Child, and Adolescent Health at WHO, with offices at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Kazuaki Miyagishima heads the Department of Food Safety, Zoonoses, and Foodborne Diseases at WHO, based at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Maria Purificación Neira is the Director of the Department of Public Health, Environmental, and Social Determinants of Health at WHO, located at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Jean-Marie Okwo-Bele serves as the Director of the Department of Immunization, Vaccines, and Biologicals at WHO, headquartered at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Professor John Charles Reeder is the Director of the Special Programme for Research and Training in Tropical Diseases at WHO, located at Avenue Appia 20, 1211 Geneva 27, Switzerland. Dr. Nadia Slimani leads the Nutritional Epidemiology Group at the International Agency for Research on Cancer, also located at 150 cours Albert Thomas, 69372 Lyon Cedex 08, France.
